home_meta_title: 24K Magic AI Dance — cruise deck video from your photo
home_meta_description: Put yourself on a night cruise deck and get a vertical dance video. {price} for 1 to 4 people. Sign in, then buy credits.
home_lead: Upload a photo and take a spot on a night cruise deck: gold light, a funk dance, a vertical video. Same idea as a Tiny Desk face swap, a different room.
home_standin: The drawing above is a stand-in. The dance clip and the track are licensed files this site does not ship. Until they are in storage, a render cannot finish.
home_step1_text: Add one to four photos. Lead is you in the center. Port, starboard, and the rail are optional friends.
home_step2_text: The whole dance is edited in one pass. Each photo replaces that dancer, and the steps stay on the beat.
home_step3_text: You get a vertical clip with the track mixed back in, and a silent copy if a platform mutes the audio.
home_diff_body: Tiny Desk AI puts people at a studio desk with a band. This site puts them on a cruise deck in a 24K Magic mood: night sea, gold light, a dance. Different keyword, different picture.
home_pricing_note: One video is the same price for 1 to 4 people. Credits never expire. If a video cannot be made, those credits come back. A finished video keeps its credits, including when a face had to be repaired.
home_faq_what_a: A vertical dance video of about 12 seconds at 720p. Your photo replaces a dancer on a night cruise deck. You also get a silent copy.
home_faq_people_a: One to four. At least the lead. Port, starboard, and the rail are optional. The price does not change.
home_faq_free_a: No. Each video runs on a paid model, so you sign in and buy a pack first.
home_faq_time_a: Plan on several minutes, often under fifteen. You can close the tab. We email you when it is ready.
home_faq_song_a: No. The track mixed into the video has to be one this site has a license for. It is not Bruno Mars' master, and this site is not affiliated with him or the label.
home_faq_photo_a: One person, face clear, from the waist up, looking toward the camera. Skip group shots, sunglasses, and heavy filters.
home_faq_rights_a: People you have permission to show, and only adults. Do not upload a celebrity or anyone who has not agreed.
home_faq_fail_a: If no video can be made, the credits come back on their own. If a face is missed, we re-render that part before delivery when the clip has been measured. A finished video is not refunded just because the likeness is close rather than exact.
